task.description:
Produce a design artefact for OIDC-08 (Standard claim mapping). Read the requirement text at docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md around line 1532 (### OIDC-08). Read the existing OIDC design files under src/design/oidc-07-claim-validation.md and src/design/oidc-04-standards-compliance-boundary.md for context on the claim verification pipeline the mapping layer feeds from. Produce src/design/oidc-08-standard-claim-mapping.md covering:

1. Public function signatures with input/output types for: claim mapping configuration storage (per-realm), the mapping function that transforms verified OIDC claims into an internal IdentityContext struct, token equivalence between providers
2. Key data structures:
   - IdentityContext: sub (external_user_id), tenant_id (optional), roles (list), email, preferred_username, display_name
   - ClaimMappingConfig: per-realm config with field-to-claim-path mappings and defaults
3. Invariants: all mapping is purely functional (no I/O); missing optional claims never produce errors; sub is always required and maps to external_user_id
4. DB tables/columns touched: configuration storage (likely extends the config source from OIDC-03), no new event-store tables
5. Cross-module dependencies: depends on OIDC-07 (verified claims as input), consumed by OIDC-09 (JIT user provisioning)
6. Identified risks or open questions

Validate: every acceptance criterion maps to a designed function/data structure.
acceptance_criteria: Every OIDC-08 acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element (function, struct, config field)
New types/structs are fully defined with field types
DB schema changes described if any

result.summary: Design artefact for OIDC-08 (Standard claim mapping). Defines ClaimMappingConfig per-realm configuration, IdentityContext canonical identity struct, pure mapVerifiedClaims() mapping function, JSON path resolver, and identity equivalence predicate. Full acceptance criterion coverage with traceability matrix. Six open questions documented.

issues.description: JSON path resolver scope limited to dot-separated object keys; array indexing excluded. Acceptable for current stage.
No hot-reload mechanism for per-realm config; restart required for config changes. Acceptable for Stage 6.5.
iss to realm normalization not fully specified; may need adapter-level override hook.
Tenant_id type mismatch policy: recommends strict rejection (type confusion is privilege-escalation risk).

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 02a) for implementation of claim mapping module
